name: Eye
summary: Big almond eye with iris, pupil and lids; anim blink closes the lids, look moves the pupil. For vision scenes.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 460 px wide

params.name: anim
params.note: blink = the lids close and open every 110 frames; look = the pupil glances left and right
